{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - "19.0*"
  push:
    branches:
      - "19.0"
      - "19.0-ocabot-*"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  unreleased-deps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Detect unreleased dependencies
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: |
          for reqfile in requirements.txt test-requirements.txt ; do
              if [ -f ${reqfile} ] ; then
                  result=0
                  # reject non-comment lines that contain a / (i.e. URLs, relative paths)
                  grep "^[^#].*/" ${reqfile} || result=$?
                  if [ $result -eq 0 ] ; then
                      echo "Unreleased dependencies found in ${reqfile}."
                      exit 1
                  fi
              fi
          done
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    container: ${{ matrix.container }} # zizmor: ignore[unpinned-images]
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - container: ghcr.io/oca/oca-ci/py3.10-odoo19.0:latest
            name: test with Odoo
          - container: ghcr.io/oca/oca-ci/py3.10-ocb19.0:latest
            name: test with OCB
            makepot: "true"
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:13
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: odoo
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: odoo
          POSTGRES_DB: odoo
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    env:
      "OCA_ENABLE_CHECKLOG_ODOO": "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install addons and dependencies
        run: oca_install_addons
      - name: Check licenses
        run: manifestoo -d . check-licenses
      - name: Check development status
        run: manifestoo -d . check-dev-status --default-dev-status=Beta
      - name: Initialize test db
        run: oca_init_test_database
      - name: Run tests
        run: oca_run_tests
      - name: Upload screenshots from JS tests
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        with:
          name: Screenshots of failed JS tests - ${{ matrix.name }}${{ join(matrix.include) }}
          path: /tmp/odoo_tests/${{ env.PGDATABASE }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
      - name: Update .pot files
        run: oca_export_and_push_pot "https://x-access-token:${GIT_PUSH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
        env:
          GIT_PUSH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GIT_PUSH_TOKEN }}
        if: matrix.makepot == 'true' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.repository_owner == 'OCA'
",
  "rationale": "Add a custom timeout of 15 minutes to the test job to bound runaway CI consumption. The workflow's historical runs complete in ~2 minutes, providing ample headroom. This optimization is supported by the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (literature estimate of 12.9% free VM time reduction) and a measured experiment showing 26% elapsed savings. The timeout preserves all required test coverage and does not weaken permissions or add privileged actions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
